name: Bell Pepper (Orange)

low.description: About 1/2 medium pepper or 3/4 cup chopped

siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to low fermentation potential and minimal fiber content compared to other vegetables.
preparationTips: Remove seeds and white pith for easier digestion
Cook lightly to soften fiber if experiencing sensitivity
Store in refrigerator for up to 1 week for best quality
Can be eaten raw or cooked without affecting FODMAP content
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of vitamin C (more than oranges)
Good source of vitamin B6 and folate
Low in calories and high in water content
